# std::shared_ptr<TerrainColliders>

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** world · **Folder:** [`src/physics/`](../folders/src-physics.md)
> **Source:** [`src/physics/terrain_colliders.h`](../../../src/physics/terrain_colliders.h), [`src/physics/terrain_colliders.cpp`](../../../src/physics/terrain_colliders.cpp), [`src/physics/physics_sys.cpp`](../../../src/physics/physics_sys.cpp)

## Summary

The world's marching-cubes collider cache, shared by WorldTerrainSys so agents can query or require ground cells.

## Description

Emplaced by WorldTerrainSys::preinit (the same object it updates every fixed tick). TerrainColliders cuts space into cells of 16^3 marching cubes (64 world units with chunk::cube_size 4); required cells are meshed on the CPU (density from a loaded ChunkVolume via ChunkMap, else TerrainGenerator::sample) and added as static MeshShape bodies (friction 0.8, static layer) in sorted (x, y, z) order; idle cells are evicted after 5 s of the caller's time. Other code (sphere roller spawn) calls require(bounds, time) and surfaceHeight / overhangAmplitude. The host's TerrainCollidersSys owns its own TerrainColliders as a unique_ptr, not in the context.
